## Why This Is Asked
Governance in multi-tenant environments hinges on tamper-proof audit trails across accounts. This checks centralized delivery, per-tenant key management, and rollback hygiene.

## Key Concepts
- CloudTrail multi-account delivery
- Cross-account IAM roles and SCPs
- S3 Object Lock Governance
- Per-tenant KMS CMKs
- Onboarding/rollback/testing processes

## Code Example
```terraform
resource "aws_cloudtrail" "tenant_trail" {
  name                          = var.tenant_id
  include_global_service_events = true
  is_multi_region_trail          = true
  enable_log_file_validation   = true
  s3_bucket_name                = "central-audit-bucket"
  s3_key_prefix                 = "logs/${var.tenant_id}"
  kms_key_id                    = aws_kms_key.tenant_kms[var.tenant_id].arn
  event_selector {
    read_write_type = "All"
  }
}
```

## Follow-up Questions
- How would you test the immutability guarantees in a simulated incident?
- What monitoring would you put on cross-account delivery failures?
